meta.prompt_source: 用户提供的题面：英语一 Part A，校园志愿活动邀请邮件

band.rationale: 对照第五档描述：本文'很好地完成了试题规定的任务'，'包含所有内容要点'（邀请目的、活动时间地点、具体安排、报名方式与截止时间齐全），'语言自然流畅，语法错误极少'（逐句核查未发现客观语言错误），'有效地采用多种衔接手法，文字连贯，层次清晰'（During the activity / If you would like to join us 等过渡自然，三段正文层次分明），'格式和语域恰当贴切'（称呼、落款、Li Ming 署名齐全，对同学语气礼貌得体），'对目标读者完全产生了预期的效果'。

sentence_edits.issue: 正式书信结尾更常用固定套语 I look forward to...；现在进行时并不影响理解，只是正式程度略低，可作为润色参考。
sentence_edits.revised: I look forward to your participation.

improved_version:
Dear classmates,

I am writing to invite you to take part in a campus volunteer activity organized by our class. The activity will be held on Saturday morning, March 15th, at the city library near our campus.

During the activity, we will help the librarians sort books, guide readers to the books they are looking for, and read stories to children. It is a valuable opportunity to serve others and gain practical experience at the same time.

If you are interested in joining us, please reply to this email before Wednesday. I look forward to your participation.

Yours sincerely,
Li Ming
top_problems: 词汇表达整体偏保守：如 a good chance 可升级为 a valuable opportunity，是本篇唯一明显可提升的空间，升级后词汇层次更贴近第五档'丰富的词汇'的上限。
结尾段信息可再充实一句集合安排（如集合时间或联系人），使邀请更具可操作性；本篇已含回复截止时间，此点仅为进一步完善方向，不影响得分档。
practice_advice: 限时 15 分钟用'表明来意—活动细节—报名号召'三段框架套写一封新话题邀请信，写完后把 chance/opportunity、take part in/join in 等同义表达轮换使用一遍，固定成自己的模板。

patterns: I am writing to invite you to take part in...
The activity will be held on + 时间, at + 地点.
During the activity, we will help..., guide..., and read...
If you would like to join us, please reply to this email before + 日期.
